doc.brief: The list of flags that can be passed to gtk_builder_create_closure().
doc.md:
The list of flags that can be passed to gtk_builder_create_closure().

New values may be added in the future for new features, so external
implementations of [`BuilderScope`](xref:gtk:Gtk.BuilderScope) should test the flags
for unknown values and raise a %GTK_BUILDER_ERROR_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE error
when they encounter one.

swapped.brief: The closure should be created swapped.
swapped.md:
The closure should be created swapped. See
  g_cclosure_new_swap() for details.
